name: search_archive
description: Semantic + visual search over every indexed camera (Cosmos Embed hybrid search on VAST). Use for any 'find / show me / when did' request. Returns numbered clips that appear on screen.

query.description: Visual description of the moment, e.g. 'white truck hits a barrier on the highway'

camera_id.description: Optional exact camera_id filter (get values from list_cameras)

location.description: Optional exact location filter (get values from list_cameras)

name: ask_archive
description: Ask a question and get a grounded answer from the VSS agent (searches captions, then writes an answer with evidence). Use for 'what happened / how many / was there' questions.

clip_id.description: Optional: restrict the answer to the parent video of this clip

name: list_cameras
description: List the filterable cameras, locations and capture types in the archive.

name: show_clip
description: Put a clip or a finished edit on the main screen. Call this after every search (best hit) and whenever the user names a clip.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

edit_id.description: Edit id like "e1" to show the before/after comparison

name: look_closer
description: Ask NVIDIA Cosmos3-Reason a specific visual question about one clip (it watches the actual video). Use for details captions may miss: colours, plates, who hit whom, damage.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: detect_objects
description: Count objects in a clip with YOLO11 (people, cars, trucks, ...).

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: summarize_video
description: Summarise the whole parent video a clip was cut from, as a timeline.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

name: edit_clip
description: Edit a clip with a generative video model (fal: Gemini Omni Flash). Removes, replaces, restyles or relights things while keeping the rest of the shot. Returns immediately with an edit id; the render takes about a minute and you will receive a system notice when it is ready.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.

instruction.description: What to change, concretely, e.g. 'remove the white truck and the debris; the lane is empty'

name: check_edit
description: Get the current status of an edit job.

name: verify_clip
description: Authenticity check. For an edit id: compares the edit with the original stored in VAST (SHA-256 fingerprints + Cosmos describing both) and reports exactly what was changed. For a clip: confirms it is untouched archive footage and lists any edits made from it.

clip_id.description: Clip number shown on screen, e.g. "3". Omit to use the clip currently on screen.
